description: Put one scene of a wiki page on other sites (PM-1076): a link anybody can open with no account, which plays the block's scene in our player and shows nothing else of the page — not its title, its words, its space or its author, only the 'caption' you give. Answers with the link and the ready <iframe> to paste into a site. The block is named by 'language' (anim, or anim-js where the company has scenes written in code) and its 'block' number among that kind's blocks, as get_wiki_page's 'anims' numbers them; the embed follows the block, so an edit of the scene shows everywhere. 'sites' limits which sites may frame it (https://example.org each; none is any); 'days' gives it a term (none is until removed). Only for somebody who may edit the page; it is a line in the page's history. delete_wiki_embed takes it down everywhere at once.

block.description: The block's number among the page's blocks of its language, from 1 — 'block' in get_wiki_page's 'anims'.

caption.description: A line shown under the scene. Optional.

days.description: Days the link answers, 1 to 3650. Optional: none is until it is removed.

sites.description: Sites that may frame it, comma-separated, as https://example.org. Optional: none is any site.

name: create_wiki_embed
